description: StoreOps evaluation rubric. Single source of truth for compute-verdict.mjs. Edit only via a reviewed change; it is a protected file during harness runs.

order: Any dimension below minDimensionRatio of its weight -> FAIL

checks.title: dependency-cruiser: 0 violations (no cross-module repository/service imports, reports read-only, no cycles)
eslint: 0 errors (includes no raw Error throws and module import restrictions)
Every cross-module side effect is raised with events.publish(<event in domainEvents.ts>); no state written to another module
Layer separation: routes only validate + call service; business rules in service; repositories only store data
Each new failure path throws the specific AppError subclass and code named in the contract
Coverage thresholds met (services 80%, routes 70%, shared 60%, overall 70% lines)
Every acceptance criterion has a test asserting the business outcome (body/state/event), not only the HTTP status
Every error-path AC is tested with an assertion on error.code
Every event published in this sprint is asserted by a test (captured bus or downstream effect)
Protected files unchanged (quality gates, rubric, skills, agents, CLAUDE.md, architecture test)
generator-summary AC table lists every contract AC and every MET claim is verified
Changed files stay within the contract's scope
README endpoint and event tables updated for new endpoints/events
No console.log in src (except server.ts) and no .only/.skip in tests
